entity_sources.name: Sanctions & PEP Coverage
entity_sources.description: Which sanctions and PEP source lists Sugra screens against, per-source freshness (max age) and covered regimes. No API key required.

entity_screen.name: Name Screening
entity_screen.description: Screen a person or organisation name against the sanctions and PEP corpus and return matching hits with scores.

params.label: Name
params.description: Person or organisation name to screen.

entity_resolve.name: Entity Resolution
entity_resolve.description: Resolve an ambiguous name to candidate corpus entities so you can pick the right one before a full screen.

params.label: Name
params.description: Name to resolve to candidate entities.

entity_batch_screen.name: Batch Screening
entity_batch_screen.description: Screen a list of names in one call — e.g. a portfolio of counterparties. Enter comma-separated names.

params.label: Names (comma-separated)
params.description: Comma-separated list of names to screen in one batch.

entity_wallet_screen.name: Wallet Screening
entity_wallet_screen.description: Screen a crypto wallet address against the sanctions corpus.

entity_id_screen.name: Document ID Screening
entity_id_screen.description: Screen a document identifier (passport, national id, ...) against the sanctions corpus.

params.label: ID value
params.description: The document identifier value to screen.

entity_kyb.name: KYB Profile
entity_kyb.description: Compose the full Know-Your-Business envelope for an entity (identity, screening, ownership, adverse media).

params.label: Anchor
params.description: Lookup anchor, e.g. name, lei, id.

params.label: Value
params.description: Anchor value, e.g. the entity name or LEI.

entity_adverse_media.name: Adverse Media
entity_adverse_media.description: Adverse-media slice of the KYB envelope for an entity.

params.label: Anchor
params.description: Lookup anchor, e.g. name, lei, id.

params.label: Value
params.description: Anchor value, e.g. the entity name or LEI.
